facts.text: Pura Batu Mejan, a centuries-old sea temple set on black rock, is by Canggu Beach near the resort.
facts.excerpt: the melody of the gamelan emitting from Pura Batu Mejan, a centuries old sea temple set on rock as black as jet

facts.text: The resort is on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong in Canggu, Kuta Utara, Bali.
facts.excerpt: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.93xx, Canggu, Bali 80361

facts.text: The architecture firm WATG combined Balinese hallmarks with clean, contemporary silhouettes.
facts.excerpt: Architecturally, WATG have sensitively married Balinese hallmarks with clean, contemporary silhouettes

facts.text: The arrival pavilion has a seven-layer carving in Javanese paras sandstone.
facts.excerpt: commissioned an immense seven-layer carving in Javanese paras sandstone for the arrival pavilion

facts.text: The furniture is bespoke and was made by the owner in Surabaya.
facts.excerpt: The furniture, all bespoke and manufactured by the owner in Surabaya, feels comfortably residential yet quite refined.

facts.text: Every room has a solid teak bathtub carved with the masked face of the mythical Barong, plus an outdoor shower.
facts.excerpt: the bathtub, solid teakwood carved intricately with the masked face of the mythical Barong creature. Regardless of room type

facts.text: Accommodation includes suites with direct lagoon access, two-bedroom penthouses and villas with private pools.
facts.excerpt: direct lagoon-access, as well as a variety of suites, two-bedroom penthouses and expansive villas with private pools

facts.text: The Beachfront Pool Villa has a private pool and uninterrupted ocean views, just steps from the shoreline.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from the shoreline, this beachfront villa pairs uninterrupted ocean views with a private 30 sqm pool

facts.text: The Refreshment Gallery's initial stock, including Bali gin, Scotch whisky, beer, jamu and local snacks, is free.
facts.excerpt: the initial stock of Bali gin and Scotch whisky, beer, soft beverages such as jamu, and locally made artisanal snacks such as Krakakoa Chocolate is gratis

facts.text: Room bookings include unlimited basic laundry service.
facts.excerpt: All day breakfast, 1 time complimentary Refreshment Gallery including alcoholic beverages and unlimited basic laundry service.

facts.text: All suites have a hidden butler's hatch behind a closet door for quiet food and drink delivery.
facts.excerpt: all the suites have a secret butler's hatch behind a closet door where food and drinks can be delivered quietly

facts.text: Regent Club access is included for villa and penthouse guests and available as an add-on for suite bookings.
facts.excerpt: is only included for villa and penthouse guests but is available as an add-on to suite bookings

facts.text: The Regent Club offers all-day dining, premium wines and spirits, afternoon tea and evening cocktails with champagne.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy refined all-day culinary offerings and a carefully curated selection of premium wines and spirits, accompanied by afternoon tea rituals and evening cocktails served with champagne.

facts.text: The Regent Club has adults-only cabanas and a private infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: relax within serene adults-only cabanas, and unwind by the private infinity pool

facts.text: Regent Club guests can join a changing lineup of Balinese cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: An ever-changing lineup of special Balinese cultural experiences is also part of the private club deal.

facts.text: Taru, the resort's signature restaurant, serves reinvented Indonesian dishes with modern techniques alongside international specialties.
facts.excerpt: Taru offers an immersive dining experience, through reinvented authentic flavours of essential Indonesian dishes, innovated by touches of modern cooking techniques and ingredients

facts.text: Sazon is a Mediterranean restaurant on Batu Bolong led by Chef Andrew Walsh.
facts.excerpt: Led by award-winning Chef Andrew Walsh, experience the neighborhood Mediterranean hideaway on Batu Bolong

facts.text: CURE bali serves a laidback take on European dining shaped by Asian flavours, by the Canggu coast.
facts.excerpt: A laidback take on European dining, gently shaped by Asian flavours. Set by the Canggu coast

facts.text: The Beach House has a pool and focuses on craft cocktails and seafood.
facts.excerpt: the Beach House lures with its shimmering pool, and ocean breeze. An ideal setting for craft cocktails and the delicate flavours of the sea.

facts.text: The Michelin Master Series brings Michelin-starred chefs from across Asia to cook at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Each edition features Michelin-starred chefs from across Asia, expressing heritage and creativity through refined seasonal menus

facts.text: The spa's wet areas include a sauna, a vitality pool and an ice bath.
facts.excerpt: including a rejuvenating sauna, a revitalising vitality pool, and an invigorating ice bath

facts.text: The Health Club has a mat-based yoga studio and a gym.
facts.excerpt: stretch, breathe and practice yoga in the mat-based studio, or elevate their heart rate in the spacious gym

facts.text: The resort has six swimming pools surrounded by cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Secluded cabanas surround the resort's six swimming pools

facts.text: The resort has nine pools.
facts.excerpt: at the pools, of which there are nine

facts.text: The pools are lined with complimentary cabanas and partly submerged loungers.
facts.excerpt: all lined with complimentary cabanas and partially submerged chaise loungers

facts.text: Two-Bedroom Suites are for families with children aged 10 and above.
facts.excerpt: Each suite offers its own living area, serene bedroom, private terrace and contemporary bathroom, surrounded by tropical foliage. For families with children aged 10 and above.

facts.text: Restaurants provide high chairs and children's tableware.
facts.excerpt: silicone bibs, cups, spoons, and plates plus high chairs were provided immediately at every restaurant

facts.text: Each guest has a personal Regent Experience Agent who acts as butler and concierge.
facts.excerpt: my personal Regent Experience Agent, who plays the role of butler and concierge

facts.text: The resort is single-use plastic free.
facts.excerpt: Already the resort is single-use plastic free

facts.text: Rainwater is collected for irrigation.
facts.excerpt: Rainwater is also collected to use for irrigation.

facts.text: The resort is not ADA compliant.
facts.excerpt: The resort is not ADA compliant

facts.text: Every teddy bear bought at the resort funds a month of learning for a child at Rumah Belajar Saab Shares in Nias.
facts.excerpt: Every teddy bear purchased at Regent Bali Canggu supports one child's learning for a month at Rumah Belajar Saab Shares in Nias.

facts.text: A green oasis of generous hospitality in Bali's buzziest area.
facts.excerpt: A green oasis of generous hospitality in Bali's buzziest area

facts.text: Regent Spa & Wellness had an anticipated opening of October 2025.
facts.excerpt: Anticipated opening October 2025.
